text:
olivia: Proposal: lift the temporary runtime pin for v3.2.1 in APAC canary tonight (APAC-west region) at 02:15 UTC. Reason: kernel microfix validated in staging and infra team cleared mem leak regression. Rollback rules: error_rate >= 2.5% for 5m OR p95 latency jump > 200ms sustained for 10m. Thoughts?
raj: I'm fine, but can we scope to APAC-west only and keep APAC-east pinned until nightly perf runs pass?
olivia: Yes APAC-west only, 3% traffic, 30m hold. East stays pinned.
kevin: Can deploy-bot do a staged unpin: start 1% -> 3% after 10m if stable? That reduces blast radius.
olivia: Good call. Plan updated: 1% initial, hold 10m, then 3% for 20m, then hold.
qa-bot: Kicking off perf suite targeted to KV-heavy prompts in APAC-west. Command: `qa run perf --job longseq --region apac-west --cohort canary --duration 40m`. Will post artifacts to https://artifacts.internal/longseq/8098765432
kevin: Also add telemetry tag `unpin=apac-west-2026-03-21` so we can filter in traces.
deploy-bot: queued: unpin runtime v3.2.1 -> apac-west canary at 02:15 UTC. Command preview: `deploybot unpin --runtime v3.2.1 --region apac-west --stages "1:10m,3:20m" --hold 1800 --auto-pin-on-sla "error>=0.025:5m,p95>200:10m" --telemetry-tag unpin=apac-west-2026-03-21`
sam: Heads-up SDK compatibility blurb ready. Python and node SDKs both have optional header fallbacks for `X-RW-KV`, so most integrations should be fine. I'll post migration notes and curl examples to docs channel after rollout.
raj: Remember dedicated fleets: not affected. Also check logs for any TLS handshake anomalies; previous AU fix touched TLS stack.
olivia: Adding TLS check in QA suite. Also drafting a small runbook for APAC ops: `if p95 spike persists >10m: deploybot.pin --runtime v3.2.1 --region apac-west && escalate to infra`
kevin: Setting up a temporary SLO in the dashboard scoped to the unpinned cohort and hooking it to deploy-bot.
olivia: All right. If no objections I'll proceed with scheduling. If QA artifacts look clean we'll go. :thumbsup:
